run_trainer_from_cli: run the fastmri trainer by calling run() with no arguments to parse CLI args and start training
run_trainer_with_dict_args: run the fastmri trainer by passing a dict of arguments to run() for programmatic configuration
run_trainer_in_eval_mode: run the fastmri trainer in evaluation mode by setting args.eval to True before calling run()
review_run_function: review the run function that dynamically imports a trainer class and calls train or eval
refactor_run_error_handling: refactor the run function to add custom exception handling or logging for uncaught errors
